Rentokil Initial to Get $180 Million for Sale of U.S. Lake Management Company to Bain Capital
By Adam Whittaker
Rentokil Initial said it expects to receive around $180 million in cash for SOLitude Lake Management after agreeing to sell the U.S. lake and pond management company to Bain Capital.
The U.K. pest-control, hygiene and workwear company said Tuesday that the planned sale supports its simplification efforts and reduces leverage.
For 2025, SOLitude generated revenue of $112 million and an adjusted operating profit of $16 million.
The transaction includes the Vertex Aquatic Solutions division. The transaction is subject to clearance and is expected to complete by early fourth-quarter this year, it said.
